name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 12 Setting Up Analytics and Tracking
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Set up GA4 and Google Search Console, define conversions and pick the metrics that show local SEO progress.

# Key points
- GA4: create the property, install via GTM or a plugin, verify in Realtime, mark key events (thank-you page views, phone clicks, form submits) as conversions.
- GSC: add a domain or URL-prefix property, verify (GA, HTML file or DNS), submit the sitemap, review Performance, Pages/coverage and Core Web Vitals.
- Metrics: organic traffic, geography, top queries, impressions, CTR, conversions from organic.
- Report monthly; compare year over year for seasonality; investigate drops.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Conversion tracking is where TAG has found the biggest problems: GHL iframe forms on Summit, Alphalete and Pipeliners stopped Google Ads conversions from firing (see [Google Ads Validation Work](lib:brain-google-ads-validation-work)).
- GSC UI is the source of truth; the Search Atlas GSC mirror is directional ([Google Search Console](lib:brain-google-search-console)).
